# LEXI Protocol

Last updated: 2026-09-24

> LEXI Protocol is compliance infrastructure that turns co-signed legal opinions into dated, scope-bound, verifiable on-chain credentials for Web3 teams operating across India, the UAE and the US. Built on Base. An engine, in development on a proprietary corpus of real regulatory work, prepares the first-pass analysis as work product; a licensed legal professional runs their own diligence and co-signs the legal opinion; the opinion becomes a credential on Base that named reliers can verify in one call.

Key facts: services are priced in USDC, never in $LEXI. 40% of protocol USDC revenue is used to buy $LEXI on-market and burn it; 60% funds the treasury; 0% goes to the co-signing professional, whose firm is retained by the protocol separately, outside LEXI. Legal professionals stake a USD-pegged $5,000 in $LEXI to be eligible to co-sign; slashing requires proven misconduct and is committee-adjudicated (reliers flag disputes, they do not slash). One assigned licensed professional co-signs each credential; there is no oracle voting. The credential is non-transferable; the opinion body stays off-chain and encrypted, with only hash commitments on-chain. A LEXI credential is not a licence, registration or regulator approval. Coverage corridor: India, UAE, US. V0 is live end to end on Base Sepolia (testnet) with VARA (Dubai) as the base jurisdiction; mainnet targeted for the fourth week of October 2026. V1 (next up): a refreshed LEXI Agent for long-horizon diligence with persistent memory and iterative agentic search across rulebooks in multiple jurisdictions, plus new jurisdictions starting with the EU (MiCA) and India (FIU-IND), so one opinion can span several. V2 (after V1): agent connectors that cross-verify protocol-asserted facts against tools such as DocuSign and GitHub, and a standalone LEXI Verification Service API for enterprise compliance and KYB workflows. No token is currently offered for sale. The founding team is Lex Arbitrage (Co-Founder and CEO, @lex_arbitrage), Karthik (Co-Founder and CTO, @implied_vol), and Ben Dhaya Ahmed (Co-Founder and CGO); the team runs a working Web3 and fintech legal practice on the corridor. LEXI Protocol has not launched a token; tokens trading under LEXI, Lexi or LexiAI names are not issued by it. Official channels: lexiprotocol.com, x.com/LEXIprotocol and linkedin.com/company/lexi-protocol. Contact: info@lexiprotocol.com.
